propositions: Test fixtures that create bare repositories and invoke Git commands with cwd=<bare> or git -C <bare> fail under safe.bareRepository=explicit policy because Git treats them as implicit repository discovery and rejects them.
The same bare-repository fixture commands succeed when explicitly targeted with top-level --git-dir instead of implicit cwd/git -C routing, and succeed under default Git configuration.
Generic worktree-oriented helpers that serve both bare repositories and worktrees cannot be blanket-converted to --git-dir without breaking worktree semantics.

The production script infra/scripts/prepare_reclaim_backup.py::_verify_restore creates a throwaway bare restore.git and routes operations through generic worktree helpers, causing the same failure under safe.bareRepository=explicit.

A narrow bare-only Git helper using explicit --git-dir targeting at confirmed test and script call sites restores fixture initialization and restore operations without weakening Git safety settings or changing unrelated error behavior.
